items.reason: Inclusion requires 'WHO grade 4 gliomas' with no IDH requirement, which D27C defines as historical glioblastoma (gbm_only, cns5_terminology historical). The trial fails S6 anyway (IL13Rα2 CAR-T is an excluded intervention type).

note: IL13Rα2 positivity is an entry requirement but is matched only to the excluded CAR-T, so it is not candidate-matched.
